description: Search and discover business leads/contacts using natural language queries. Finds people matching your ideal customer profile and can enrich them with verified contact details and AI-powered insights. Returns 30 leads by default; pass limit for more (max 1000). Uses credits (from 0.1 per lead, more with insights or contact details); precept_check_credits shows the balance. Runs asynchronously and returns an enrichment_id (jobId). Check progress with precept_get_job_status; jobs can take up to about 10 minutes, so checking every ~4 seconds for up to about 150 checks before treating a job as stalled gives the best experience, with a brief progress update to the user every minute or so. Results work well as a table. Users often follow up by asking for more leads or for emails and phone numbers via precept_enrich_leads.

enrichType.description: Type of contact details to find. Options: 'emails' (+1 credit/lead), 'phones' (+10 credits/lead). Default: both (+11 credits/lead). Only used when includeContactDetails is true.

findInsights.description: Generate AI insights for each lead including professional summary, top problems, internal strategic initiatives, and public appearances. Costs 1.1 credits per lead if true, 0.1 credits if false. Default: false.

includeContactDetails.description: Whether to find and verify email addresses and phone numbers for each discovered lead. Enables waterfall search across 140+ data providers (+1 credit for email per lead, +10 for phone per lead, or +11 for both per lead). Increases processing time significantly for phone numbers. Contact details add significant cost, so enable this when the user asks for emails or phone numbers.

limit.description: Maximum number of leads to return (max 1000). Defaults to 30.

name.description: A readable name for this enrichment job, used for searching on the Precept dashboard.

query.description: Natural language search query describing the target persona and company (e.g. 'Marketing heads at SaaS companies in California', 'CTOs at fintech startups in London with 50-200 employees').

signal.description: Optional LinkedIn activity signal for filtering persona search. Finds leads matching your query who recently engaged with relevant posts. Adds +5 credits per lead. (For discovering leads directly from post authors matching keywords without a persona query, use precept_get_leads_from_post_search).

keywords.description: 1 to 5 keywords or phrases to find leads who recently engaged (posted, liked, commented) with relevant content.

streamingResults.description: Optional. When true (and webhookUrl is provided), contact results are progressively streamed to the webhook as each lead is enriched. NOT needed when polling with precept_get_job_status.

webhookUrl.description: Optional webhook URL to receive enrichment results. NOTE: NOT needed for MCP assistant workflows. You can omit this and use precept_get_job_status with the returned enrichment_id to fetch the results directly.

name: precept_search_leads

outputSchema.description: Initialization response containing the jobId to poll for results

enrichment_id.description: The unique job ID to poll with precept_get_job_status

finalLimit.description: Adjusted limit based on available credit balance

message.description: Status message describing the initialized job

title: Search Leads
